summary: This sheet provides toilet room plans, detailing ADA compliance, and associated signage and fixture information.

published.title: Door push/pull pressure discrepancy
published.observation: There are two conflicting notes regarding door push/pull pressure: one reads 'max. of 5# push/pull press/sweep period from 70 degrees to a point 3" from latch must be at least 3 seconds' and another reads 'from 10 degrees to a point 3" from latch must be at least 3 seconds'.
published.drawing_evidence: The first note is located in the top left quadrant, and the second in the bottom left quadrant.
published.recommendation: Verify and correct the door closing annotations to reduce ambiguity, ensuring ADA compliance.
